role: prespecified secondary analysis of an already accessed OSDR development cohort; characterization only, never confirmation

questions.q_a: Does a deployable learned representation beat raw expression and fold-fit PCA?
questions.q_b: Does organ specialization beat pooling while holding the representation family fixed?

shared_evaluation.convergence: fail closed at 10000 iterations and tolerance 1e-3

e1_muscle_only.membership: exact skeletal_muscle subset of frozen cohort
e1_muscle_only.q_b_comparisons: true-organ, blind-hard, and blind-soft versus pooled_hidden, per model seed
e1_muscle_only.q_a_comparisons: deployable blind-hard and blind-soft versus raw_expression and pca_64, per model seed
e1_muscle_only.purpose: localize retained signal and estimate specialization versus pooling; raw-expression ceiling is expected and not a gate failure

e2_residuals.residuals: observed score-panel expression minus frozen predicted score panel
e2_residuals.scientific_gate: a fixed specialized residual must beat residual_pooled and score_panel_within_organ_centered_fold_fit in every model seed with paired study-bootstrap lower bounds above zero
e2_residuals.deployment_gate: a fixed blind residual must additionally beat raw_expression, pca_64, and full_raw_within_organ_centered_fold_fit in every model seed
e2_residuals.fold_firewall: organ means are estimated on each training fold only and applied unchanged to validation or test rows

e3_low_label.sampling: within each outer-training partition, select paired classes within randomly ordered training studies; use at least three studies and fail closed if either class or grouped inner folds are infeasible
e3_low_label.test_policy: score the complete untouched outer test studies
e3_low_label.gate: the same fixed learned representation must beat raw_expression at both 5% and 10% with the across-subsample interval above zero in all three model seeds

e4_specialization_estimand.comparisons: true-organ, blind-hard, and blind-soft against the matched pooled representation
e4_specialization_estimand.reporting: per seed only; never average away a seed reversal; paired study bootstrap

interpretation_firewalls.signal_wording: skeletal muscle is the dominant and only adequately powered organ-specific signal; do not claim it is the only possible signal
